name: fritzfluxdb
description: Daemon that reads metrics from an AVM Fritz!Box (DSL/Cable, WLAN, VPN, home automation, logs) and writes them to InfluxDB v1, InfluxDB v2, or QuestDB. No Web UI. Configured entirely via environment variables. Grafana dashboards included. Pick your backend with "Database Type", then fill in the shared "Database ..." fields. QuestDB Open Source supports optional HTTP basic authentication, not API tokens. Source: https://github.com/Gill-Bates/fritzfluxdb

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone (e.g. Europe/Berlin, Etc/UTC). Fritz!Box timezone is auto-detected at startup.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log level.

variables.name: Fritz!Box Hostname/IP
variables.description: Hostname or IP of the Fritz!Box on your LAN.

variables.name: Fritz!Box Username
variables.description: Fritz!Box login username.

variables.name: Fritz!Box Password
variables.description: Fritz!Box login password.

variables.name: Fritz!Box Port
variables.description: Fritz!Box TR-064 port.

variables.name: Fritz!Box Connect Timeout (s)
variables.description: Connection timeout in seconds.

variables.name: Fritz!Box Request Interval (s)
variables.description: Seconds between TR-064 poll cycles (minimum 10).

variables.name: Fritz!Box Box Tag
variables.description: Custom tag to identify the Fritz!Box.

variables.name: Fritz!Box Timezone
variables.description: Fallback timezone for Fritz!Box log timestamps if auto-detection fails.

variables.name: Include VPN Address Metrics
variables.description: Leave empty to exclude VPN address metrics; enter 1, true, yes, or on to include them.

variables.name: Database Type
variables.description: Target database. InfluxDB v1 needs a database name; InfluxDB v2 needs token, organization and bucket; QuestDB needs a host and optionally HTTP basic credentials.

variables.name: Database Hostname/IP
variables.description: Hostname or IP of the target database (InfluxDB or QuestDB). A full URL is also accepted, e.g. https://questdb.example.com, in which case TLS and port are taken from the URL.

variables.name: Database Port
variables.description: Leave EMPTY to use the correct default for the selected Database Type (8086 for InfluxDB, 9000 for QuestDB). Only set this if your database listens on a non-standard port.

variables.name: Database TLS
variables.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for the database connection.

variables.name: Database Verify TLS
variables.description: Verify the database TLS certificate.

variables.name: Database Allow Plaintext Credentials
variables.description: Allow sending credentials/token over plain HTTP to a remote host (trusted networks only).

variables.name: Measurement / Table Name
variables.description: InfluxDB measurement resp. QuestDB table name (overridden by the Fritz!Box serial number if available).

variables.name: Database Name (InfluxDB v1)
variables.description: InfluxDB v1 database name. Required for DB_TYPE=influxdb_v1, ignored otherwise.

variables.name: Database Username (InfluxDB v1 / QuestDB)
variables.description: Username for InfluxDB v1 or QuestDB basic authentication (optional). For InfluxDB v1 it must be set together with the password.

variables.name: Database Password (InfluxDB v1 / QuestDB)
variables.description: Password for InfluxDB v1 or QuestDB basic authentication (optional). For InfluxDB v1 it must be set together with the username.

variables.name: Token (InfluxDB v2)
variables.description: InfluxDB v2 API token (required for DB_TYPE=influxdb_v2). QuestDB Open Source does not support API tokens.

variables.name: Organization (InfluxDB v2)
variables.description: InfluxDB v2 organization name. Required for DB_TYPE=influxdb_v2, ignored otherwise.

variables.name: Bucket (InfluxDB v2)
variables.description: InfluxDB v2 bucket. Required for DB_TYPE=influxdb_v2, ignored otherwise.

variables.name: Data Retention (days, QuestDB only)
variables.description: QuestDB only: TTL in days, applied only to a table without an existing TTL; 0 disables it (requires QuestDB 8.2.2+). Ignored for InfluxDB.

variables.name: Downsampling (QuestDB only)
variables.description: Optional QuestDB rollup profile: low (30 days raw, 1-minute rollup), medium (7 days raw, 1-minute rollup), or high (1 day raw, 5-minute rollup). Leave empty to disable.
